import importlib
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from userlib.core import fetch_user_name, get_user_name_legacy

for path in Path('userlib').glob('*.py'):
    original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{path}'], text=True)
    assert path.read_text() == re.sub(r'\bget_user_name\b', 'fetch_user_name', original), path

for user in [
    {'first': 'Ada', 'last': 'Lovelace'},
    {'first': '', 'last': ''},
    {'first': 'Zoë', 'last': '李'},
]:
    expected_name = user['first'] + ' ' + user['last']
    expected_legacy = user['last'] + ', ' + user['first']
    assert fetch_user_name(user) == expected_name
    assert get_user_name_legacy(user) == expected_legacy
    for index in range(8):
        module = importlib.import_module(f'userlib.feature_{index}')
        assert module.label(user) == expected_name + ' / ' + expected_legacy

print('Verified exact rename only, unchanged legacy function, and behavior across all 8 feature modules.')
PY
